sites.name: Bach Dang Giang Relic Site
sites.event: A relic complex marking 3 heroic naval battles on the Bach Dang River associated with the heroes: Ngo Quyen (938), Le Dai Hanh (981), and Tran Hung Dao (1288).

sites.name: Cat Ba Archipelago (Cat Ba National Park)
sites.event: A UNESCO-recognized world biosphere reserve, conserving the rare Cat Ba langur and a diverse ecosystem.

sites.name: Lan Ha Bay
sites.event: One of the most beautiful bays in the world, adjacent to Ha Long Bay with hundreds of limestone islands and pristine beaches.

sites.name: K15 Pier (The Numberless Pier)
sites.event: The starting point of the legendary 'Numberless Ships', opening the Ho Chi Minh Trail at sea to provide support for the Southern battlefield.

sites.name: Hai Phong Opera House
sites.event: One of the three largest opera houses in Vietnam built during the French colonial period (1904-1912), an architectural and cultural symbol of the Port City.

sites.name: Hon Dau Island
sites.event: Home to the oldest lighthouse in Vietnam (built in 1892) and the temple of Nam Hai Than Vuong.

sites.name: Voi Mountain
sites.event: An important base of our country during the Mac Dynasty and the two resistance wars against the French and Americans; home to caves with traces of prehistoric humans.

place.commune: An Tien Commune, Truong Thanh Commune

sites.name: Tuong Long Tower
sites.event: The Tuong Long Tower was built during the reign of King Ly Thanh Tong (1058), once a major Buddhist center in the coastal region.

sites.name: Du Hang Pagoda (Phuc Lam Temple)
sites.event: A famous ancient pagoda, rumored to date back to the Early Le Dynasty, preserving many precious relics and exquisite carved architecture.

sites.name: Mac Dynasty Memorial Site
sites.event: A place of worship for the kings and famous generals of the Mac Dynasty, located on the birthplace of the Mac Dynasty (Co Trai).

sites.name: Tuyet Tinh Coc (Blue Lake)
sites.event: An artificial lake (due to stone quarrying) with a unique turquoise color, which is a famous check-in spot.
